caption: The drawing depicts a cluster of buildings surrounded by trees and grassy areas. The buildings are arranged in a somewhat rectangular composition, with various structures in white and red; the white buildings have green shutters and red chimneys, while the red ones have lighter roof and window details. The roofs are mostly dark gray, with some lighter tones. There are multiple small trees, mostly green, planted in an orderly fashion along paths and open spaces around the buildings. A wooden fence appears along part of the property. There is a blue, red, and brown rooster on the left side of the sky, and a lighter, less defined bird on the right. The ground is shaded in green and brown tones, and the background is filled with pale, cloudy hues. Handwritten text near the bottom center reads “SECOND FAMILY ALFRED, ME.”
title: Second Family House, Alfred, ME.
